lead: Importing Indian kurtis, kurta sets or Anarkali suits for your US boutique or online store? Duties and rules changed a lot in 2025–2026. Here is a plain guide to tariffs, the end of the $800 de minimis, documents and labelling.
seo_title: Import Kurtis from India to USA Wholesale: 2026 Tariffs & Rules
seo_description: Guide for US boutiques importing Indian kurtis: 2026 tariffs on India, end of $800 de minimis, EIN, informal vs formal entry, labelling rules and MOQ from Jaipur.
body:
## Quick answer

Indian-made women's garments entering the USA pay the **normal (MFN) duty** for their HTS code **plus an additional 10% tariff on Indian goods** (as of November 2026). The **$800 de minimis exemption is suspended**, so every shipment pays duty. Shipments up to **$2,500** can usually use **informal entry**; above that you need a **formal entry and customs bond**. Garments must carry **fibre content, "Made in India" and care labels**.

## Duty at a glance

| Item | USA rule (Nov 2026) |
|---|---|
| Base duty (MFN) | Depends on the HTS line and fibre; cotton is lower than synthetic fabrics like georgette |
| Additional tariff on Indian goods | 10% |
| De minimis ($800) | Suspended – all shipments pay duty |
| Informal entry | Up to $2,500 |
| Typical express transit from India | About 3–6 days |

Because rates depend on the exact HTS line, ask your customs broker for the rate on each style before you order in bulk.

## Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **EIN** (or CBP-assigned importer number)
- A **customs bond** for formal entries over $2,500

## Labelling (required)

Under the US Textile Act and FTC rules, garments need:
- **Fibre content** (e.g. "100% Cotton")
- **Country of origin** ("Made in India")
- **Manufacturer or dealer identity** (RN number or company name)
- A permanent **care label**

We can stitch labels to your specifications.

## Tips to manage costs

- Choose **cotton** styles where possible, as cotton often has a lower base duty than synthetics
- Consolidate orders into fewer, larger shipments
- Factor duty into your retail price from the start

faq.q: What is the tariff on clothing from India to the USA in 2026?
faq.a: Indian garments pay the normal MFN duty for their HTS code plus an additional 10% tariff on Indian goods (as of November 2026). The exact base rate depends on the HTS line and fibre, so confirm it with a customs broker.

faq.q: Is the $800 de minimis still available for Indian clothing?
faq.a: No. The de minimis exemption is suspended, so all shipments pay duty.

faq.q: What labels do Indian kurtis need in the USA?
faq.a: Fibre content, country of origin (Made in India), manufacturer or dealer identity such as an RN number, and a permanent care label.
